title: 1954 Atomic Energy Act moved craft custody to contractor-operated labs

tellings.quote: different mind. I think that craft was moved in 1954 because the 1954 atomic energy agreement gave expanded powers to government-owned contractor operated laboratories like Sandia and so forth to house the craft.

plain: A researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb believes that a recovered craft of unknown origin was moved in 1954, because the Atomic Energy Act of that year gave new powers to government-owned labs run by private contractors, such as Sandia, to keep it. He gives this as his own reading and names no source. If he is right, it would explain how such objects could end up held by companies, out of public reach.
